issue.title: Gateway byte-range media route for streaming and seeking video artifacts

task_type_fields.proposal:
Add an HTTP byte-range media route (Range requests answered with 206 Partial Content) for artifact files to the SASE gateway. Web, mobile, and remote frontends could then stream and seek video artifacts without downloading the whole file first. Shared backend behavior belongs in sase-core under the Rust core backend boundary, so this likely needs a sase-core route plus binding and pin updates.

Proposed by phase bead sase-1tb.6 (motion-handoff) note #4 and routed here by the sase-1tb land agent. Background: research:202611/fast_video_artifact_pane/fast_video_artifact_pane.md.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1tb stayed in the Python TUI (requirement R9) and listed "No sase-core or gateway work" as a non-goal. The gateway route was deferred by name in its plan's "Deferred" list.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1tb excluded gateway work and deferred a byte-range media route; phase sase-1tb.6 proposed it as a follow-up and the epic lander is routing it to the backlog.
